name: The Helvault
description: A prison in which Griselbrand trapped Avacyn; it was later sundered.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.
